# Sailing Naturali

> A tech executive is upending their life to build a premium all-electric sailing charter in the Pacific Northwest — still at the desk, pointed at the sea, documenting the leap. AI clears the path; presence is the point.

## Pages

- [Sailing Naturali — a tech exec's leap to an all-electric charter](https://sailingnaturali.com): A tech executive is upending their life to build a premium all-electric sailing charter in the Pacific Northwest — still at the desk, pointed at the sea, documenting the leap. AI clears the path; presence is the point.
- [Itineraries — Sailing Naturali](https://sailingnaturali.com/itineraries): The charter trips we’re planning aboard an all-electric catamaran in the Pacific Northwest — a Gulf Islands loop, a Desolation Sound expedition, a Sunshine Coast passage, and the far-north Broughtons. In development.
